question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

The transistors are used as the main ________, which are built into computer chips.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"components"** refers to parts or elements that make up a larger system or structure. (घटक)

 
 
• **Example: **The engine is one of the most important **components **of a car.
 
 
 
• **"Components"** are essential parts that are used to build or assemble something larger. (घटक)
 
 
• **Example: **The transistors are used as the main **components**, which are built into computer chips.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
